Mysuru.desc: The former capital of the Wadiyar dynasty, dominated by the grand Mysuru Palace that blends Indo-Saracenic, Rajput, Hindu and Gothic styles. Road trippers from Bengaluru make it the classic first stop for the overnight palace light-up. (sourced from r/travel Top 10 Places in Mysuru)

Kushalnagar.desc: The main town on the Mysore–Coorg road, ~35 km from Madikeri. Road trippers heading to Coorg usually stop here for brunch and to visit the Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple), one of the largest Tibetan monasteries in India. (sourced from r/coorg trip planning threads)
